args: PORTAINER_URL=https://portainer.nicolkrit.ch PORTAINER_TLS_VERIFY=0 PORTAINER_API_KEY=$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_portainer_token) PORTAINER_EXPOSE_ENV_VALUES=1 exec uvx --from 'mcp-portainer~=2.42.0' mcp-portainer
BESZEL_URL=https://beszel.nicolkrit.ch BESZEL_EMAIL="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_beszel_email)" BESZEL_PASSWORD="$(cat /run/secrets/claude_mcp_beszel_password)" exec npx -y beszel-mcp

B=$(command -v google-chrome-stable || command -v brave || true); if [ -n "$B" ]; then exec npx -y @playwright/mcp --browser chromium --executable-path "$B" --user-data-dir "$HOME/.claude/playwright-profile" --output-dir "$HOME/.cache/playwright-mcp"; else exec npx -y @playwright/mcp --browser firefox --user-data-dir "$HOME/.claude/playwright-profile" --output-dir "$HOME/.cache/playwright-mcp"; fi
